headline: Ask Automotive reports GST department search at its manufacturing unit
hook: GST authorities inspect Ask Automotive plant
summary: Ask Automotive has informed the exchanges that the GST department has initiated an inspection or search at one of its manufacturing facilities. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of SEBI listing regulations. Such routine tax department searches can occasionally lead to short-term operational scrutiny for listed manufacturing companies. Indian retail investors holding the stock should monitor subsequent company disclosures regarding the findings of this inspection.
whats_next: Official company clarification regarding the GST search outcome
why_it_matters: Tax authority scrutiny can create short-term sentiment pressure on the stock

headline: Choice Broking initiates 'Buy' on ASK Automotive
hook: Choice Broking sees further upside for ASK
summary: ASK Automotive shares have gained 46% over the last six months and 32.14% annually. Choice Institutional Equities has initiated coverage on the stock with a 'Buy' rating. The brokerage projects a 20% EBITDA CAGR through FY29, driven by the company's Aluminium Lightweighting Precision Solutions segment. This outlook suggests potential for an additional 20% upside from current levels.
why_it_matters: Brokerage optimism may drive further momentum in ASK Automotive shares.
